metadata.description:
Today’s bulletin delves into the growing tensions surrounding displacement and the repeated injustices faced by tribal communities across several states. In Chhattisgarh’s Hasdeo forest, tribals opposing deforestation were met with police force, sparking outrage over the continued exploitation of their lands. Meanwhile, in Madhya Pradesh’s Mandla District, government authorities have arrived to conduct surveys for the Basnia dam project, despite earlier assurances that the proposal had been withdrawn, leaving the local tribal community feeling deceived.
In Tripura, a tribal man died tragically after being subjected to police torture and later released from custody. His death has ignited protests and raised serious concerns about the treatment of indigenous populations by law enforcement.
Additionally, the bulletin will cover the recent meeting between Manipur’s tribal MLAs and the Home Minister, addressing ongoing political and social concerns in the region.
Stay tuned for an in-depth look at these pressing issues affecting tribal communities across India.
